svg.title: Yaseen Mohammad — Full-Stack Developer terminal profile
svg.desc: A light engineering console. On the left, a particle point cloud forms a portrait of Yaseen Mohammad, then reorganizes into a shipping container, a logistics yard, a software architecture diagram and a 3D wireframe before returning to the portrait. On the right, a system information panel lists role, location, focus and technology stack.

g.aria-label: Animated particle point cloud morphing from a portrait into a container, a yard, an architecture diagram and a 3D cube
